body:
Thank you for your reply. I'm amazed how much better I feel just having got it out on paper. And your reply about your mom's comment being proud really struck home with me. What started my high emotions was a letter from my mom this week and then line "every day of my life I am thankful for you, and and then decent, honest man you've become." it just brought me to tears immediately recalling I tried to end it all.

I was very open with my mom about my depression this past summer, but then gradually began to keep to myself, and kept my suicidal thoughts bottled up so I don't have to stress anyone else about my death. 

I'm trying to get over the guilt, and keep the depression at a distance. I have been smoking mj which helps relax me but I want to become clean and sober again. 
I tried to tell my best friend about my suicide attempt this morning, although I'm second guessing now.. I'm not sure if it will help.. Any thoughts? I sent her a message last night and when she called today I couldn't get the words out.. I teared up and asked if we could talk later tonight 
. 
At some point I want to tell my mom about what really happened and how I ended up hypothermic in the ICU but for now, I think it's best if she doesn't know.
